module web.page_title
  purpose: Download a web page and measure the length of its title.

import std.http as web

public type PageError is one of
  purpose: Why a page title could not be measured.
  FetchFailed(detail: Text)
  NoTitle(detail: Text)
end

public function title_length(html: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  purpose: Count the characters between the title tags of an HTML text.
  tags: html, title
  example: title_length("<html><title>Hello</title></html>") is 5

  let start be html.index_of("<title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle(detail: "the page has no title element")
  let after_open be html.drop(start + 7)
  let stop be after_open.index_of("</title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle(detail: "the title element is never closed")
  let title be after_open.take(stop).trim()
  if title.is_empty() then
    fail with NoTitle(detail: "the title element is empty")
  end
  return title.length()
end

public function page_title_length(address: Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the page at the given address and return how many characters its title has.
  tags: web, title
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(address) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(detail: "could not download {address}")
  return title_length(page)
end

module page_title
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http as web
import std.http exposing Url

public type TitleError is one of
  purpose: Why a page title could not be measured.
  BadUrl(address: Text)
  FetchFailed(address: Text)
  NoTitle(address: Text)
end

public function extract_title(html: Text)
  returns maybe Text
  purpose: Find the trimmed text between the title tags, or nothing when the page has none.
  tags: html, text
  example: extract_title("<html><head><title> Hello </title></head></html>") is "Hello"
  example: extract_title("<html><body>No head</body></html>") is nothing

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let open_at be lowered.index_of("<title>") otherwise return nothing
  let rest be html.drop(open_at + 7)
  let close_at be rest.to_lower().index_of("</title>") otherwise return nothing
  return rest.take(close_at).trim()
end

public function title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the page at the address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing with NoTitle when it has none.
  tags: web, agents
  see also: extract_title
  expose as tool

  let url be Url(address) otherwise fail with BadUrl(address: address)
  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(address: address)
  let title be extract_title(page.body) otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  return title.length()
end

module page.titles
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http
import std.http exposing Url

public type TitleError is one of
  purpose: Why a page title could not be measured.
  FetchFailed(detail: Text)
  MissingTitle(detail: Text)
  UnclosedTitle(detail: Text)
end

public function title_length(html: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  purpose: Count the characters in the text of the first title element of an HTML document.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
  example: title_length("<TITLE>  Hi there </TITLE>") is 8

  let lower be html.to_lower()
  let open_at be lower.index_of("<title>") otherwise fail with MissingTitle(detail: "the page has no title element")
  let after be html.drop(open_at + 7)
  let lower_after be after.to_lower()
  let close_at be lower_after.index_of("</title>") otherwise fail with UnclosedTitle(detail: "the title element is never closed")
  let title be after.take(close_at)
  return title.trim().length()
end

public function page_title_length(url: Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title.
  tags: web, agent
  expose as tool

  let page be http.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(detail: "the page could not be downloaded")
  let count be title_length(page) otherwise fail
  return count
end
